title: Technology Risk Director (Hybrid)
description: At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team. Broadridge is seeking a Technology Risk Director to join our growing Technology Risk organization. This role will support the identification, assessment, monitoring, and reporting of technology risks across infrastructure, cloud platforms, applications, cybersecurity, data, and emerging technologies. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background combined with a risk management mindset and an understanding of modern technology environments. The role requires close collaboration with engineering, infrastructure, cybersecurity, architecture, and business teams to ensure technology risks are effectively identified, assessed, and managed. Responsibilities Technology Risk Management Conduct technology risk assessments across infrastructure, applications, cloud platforms, and technology services. Identify technology risks, control gaps, and potential business impacts. Evaluate inherent and residual risks and support risk treatment planning. Monitor and track technology risk remediation activities through closure. Support Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSA) and technology risk governance activities. Technology Governance & Risk Oversight Partner with technology teams to ensure risks are appropriately identified, documented, and managed. Review new technology initiatives, architecture changes, and strategic programs from a risk perspective. Provide effective challenge and independent risk perspectives on technology decisions. Support the development and maintenance of technology risk policies, standards, and governance processes. Cloud, Infrastructure & Application Risk Assess risks associated with cloud environments, infrastructure platforms, applications, and technology operations. Review identity and access management, resilience, availability, data protection, and security controls from a risk perspective. Evaluate risks associated with modern architectures including APIs, microservices, containers, and cloud-native platforms. Support technology resilience and recovery risk assessments. Emerging Technology & AI Risk Support governance and risk assessments for Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI solutions. Evaluate risks related to data privacy, model governance, explainability, security, and responsible AI practices. Monitor emerging technology trends and assess associated risk implications. Assist in developing risk management approaches for emerging technologies and innovation initiatives. Automation & Continuous Risk Monitoring Leverage automation and analytics to improve technology risk identification and monitoring. Develop dashboards, reporting, and risk metrics using tools such as Python, SQL, Power BI, or similar technologies. Support continuous monitoring capabilities for key technology risk indicators. Identify opportunities to streamline risk processes through automation and AI-enabled solutions. Risk Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement Prepare risk reports, dashboards, and management presentations. Support development of Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and technology risk metrics. Communicate technology risks clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Partner with global technology, cybersecurity, compliance, and enterprise risk teams. Qualifications 5+ years of experience in Technology Risk, Information Security, Technology Governance, Cyber Risk, Cloud Risk, Infrastructure Engineering, Technology Operations, or related disciplines. Experience working within large-scale enterprise technology environments. Experience assessing risks associated with cloud, infrastructure, applications, cybersecurity, or technology transformation initiatives. Technical Knowledge Strong understanding of several of the following areas: Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) Infrastructure and platform technologies Identity and Access Management (IAM) Cybersecurity principles and controls Networking and distributed systems Application development and SDLC DevOps and CI/CD practices Databases and data management Technology resilience and disaster recovery APIs, containers, and microservices architectures Automation & Analytics Experience with one or more of the following: Python SQL Power BI Power Automate Tableau Data analytics and reporting platforms AI & Emerging Technology Knowledge Understanding of Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI technologies. Knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI principles, and technology risk implications. Awareness of emerging technology trends and associated risk management considerations. Frameworks & Standards Familiarity with technology risk and cybersecurity frameworks such as: NIST Cybersecurity Framework NIST AI Risk Management Framework COBIT CIS Controls FFIEC Technology Risk Guidance ISO 27001 Certifications (Preferred) One or more

title: Security GRC Lead
description: ABOUT MERCOR Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents. Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices. ROLE DESCRIPTION You'll be the first GRC hire at a company that processes some of the most sensitive data on earth: training data, evals, and human-feedback pipelines for the frontier AI labs, plus payments and KYC for 300K+ experts. This is not an audit-theater role. You'll own the operating cadence of a continuously-audited company: continuous SOC 2 monitoring, the active ISO 27001 buildout, an annual customer audit every quarter, and a sub-48-hour questionnaire SLA. You'll write controls in code where it makes sense, push back on tools that fight you, and own the artifacts that close enterprise deals. We use AI heavily in our own GRC work. You should be comfortable using LLMs to draft, review, and respond at speed. If you've ever copy-pasted the same answer into 14 vendor questionnaires by hand, you'll appreciate not having to. We're in-person five days a week at our SF headquarters, with first Fridays remote. Policy lifecycle owned end-to-end: version, attestation, exception handling, review cycle - not a SharePoint graveyard - Controls-as-code where it makes sense: integrations, policy packs, rules tied to SOC 2 CC categories, automated evidence collection - Data-handling procedures: the customer-data-deletion gap, DSAR workflow, KMS scheduled destruction, offboarding handlers - The internal trust narrative: customer trust pages, security one-pagers, executive-ready disclosure templates when something goes sideways WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 7+ years in security GRC, compliance engineering, or audit, with at least 2 years owning a SOC 2 Type 2 program end-to-end at a company under audit by enterprise customers - You've shipped at least one ISO 27001 certification from kickoff to issued certificate, including Stage 1 and Stage 2 with a real registrar - Fluent in Vanta (or Drata, Secureframe, Sprinto) at the integration and admin level, not just the reviewer UI - you've configured connectors, written custom tests, debugged broken evidence - You translate cloud-security language to auditor language and back without losing precision - you can read a Wiz finding, a Panther rule, an IAM policy, and say what control it maps to - You write controls as code or query evidence with SQL when the platform falls short - Python, SQL, or shell, whatever it takes - You know the difference between "we don't have a control for that" and "we have a compensating control" and you don't fabricate the second one - Direct experience with the customer-trust surface: SIG, CAIQ, custom enterprise questionnaires, on-site auditor sessions, disclosure letters under legal review BONUS POINTS - Built or operated a GRC program inside an AI lab, ML platform, or company serving frontier labs as customers - Familiar with AI-specific frameworks: NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act conformity, ISO 42001 - Experience with FedRAMP Moderate, HIPAA, PCI DSS, or SOC 2 + HITRUST dual scope - You've automated questionnaire response with an LLM and know where it works and where it fails - Prior experience standing up a third-party risk program from zero - vendor intake, recurring review, contract teeth - Written a public trust page that customers actually trust WHY MERCOR - Build the function, don't inherit it. About the Role We are seeking a highly motivated Revenue Accounting Manager to independently manage complex revenue accounting activities and lead improvement to revenue accounting systems and processes. This individual contributor role is ideal for someone with a strong technical accounting background who has experience applying ASC 606 who has an interest in applying the latest technology to help the revenue organization to scale effectively as the business continues to grow in size and complexity. Demonstrated ability to adapt to new systems, tools, processes, and evolving business requirements Experience with ERP, revenue recognition, billing, CRM, or data analytics tools preferred. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with attention to detail. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands. About the Role We are seeking a commercially minded Senior Legal Counsel to join our growing legal team and support the company's global sales organisation. This is a highly collaborative role that requires strong partnership with Sales and other business stakeholders, providing pragmatic legal advice while ensuring that legal, regulatory and commercial risks are appropriately identified, assessed and managed. The successful candidate will act as a trusted adviser to the business, helping stakeholders navigate complex customer negotiations while exercising sound judgement regarding risk. They will understand when to find creative solutions to move discussions forward and when it is necessary to escalate, challenge assumptions or recommend alternative approaches to protect the company's interests. This role is ideal for a confident, adaptable lawyer who thrives in a fast-paced software environment, enjoys tackling complex negotiations, and is passionate about helping the business succeed. What You’ll Do Build trusted relationships with Sales, Deal Desk, Revenue Operations and other business stakeholders to support customer and channel transactions. Lead the review, drafting and negotiation of a wide range of commercial agreements, including SaaS, BaaS, software, professional services, channel (including aggregator, reseller and GSI relationships) and NDAs. Provide practical, commercially focused legal advice to Sales and business stakeholders, supporting negotiations through clear, pragmatic guidance while identifying, communicating and managing material legal, regulatory, privacy and commercial risks, and advising on compliance requirements, data protection obligations and internal approval processes. Develop practical and defensible solutions to complex contractual and commercial issues, applying sound judgement to balance risk, identify appropriate mitigations and determine when escalation is required. Anticipate potential contractual, legal or operational issues and take proactive steps to address them efficiently and reduce the risk of disputes or delays. Collaborate effectively with colleagues across the Legal department and contribute to a positive, high-performing team culture. Extensive experience negotiating complex customer and partner agreements. Demonstrated ability to advise business stakeholders in a practical, succinct and commercially focused manner. Experience supporting sales organizations and working closely with commercial stakeholders in a fast-moving environment. Experience advising on privacy and data protection issues arising in commercial technology transactions, including customer contracting requirements relating to the processing, transfer, storage and protection of data.
